segments.ja456:1.1: Suṇohi mayhaṃ vacanaṃ janinda, atthena juṇhamhi idhānupatto;
segments.ja456:1.3: Na brāhmaṇe addhike tiṭṭhamāne, gantabba [gantabya (ka.)] māhu dvipadinda [dipadāna (sī. pī.), dvipadāna (syā.)] seṭṭha.
segments.ja456:2.1: Suṇomi tiṭṭhāmi vadehi brahme, yenāsi [yenāpi (syā. ka.)] atthena idhānupatto;
segments.ja456:2.3: Kaṃ vā tvamatthaṃ mayi patthayāno, idhāgamā brahme tadiṅgha brūhi.
segments.ja456:3.1: Dadāhi me gāmavarāni pañca, dāsīsataṃ satta gavaṃsatāni;
segments.ja456:3.3: Parosahassañca suvaṇṇanikkhe, bhariyā ca me sādisī dve dadāhi.
segments.ja456:4.1: Tapo nu te brāhmaṇa bhiṃsarūpo, mantā nu te brāhmaṇa cittarūpā;
segments.ja456:4.3: Yakkhā nu [yakkhā va (sī. pī.)] te assavā santi keci, atthaṃ vā me abhijānāsi kattaṃ.
segments.ja456:5.1: Na me tapo atthi na cāpi mantā, yakkhāpi me assavā natthi keci;
segments.ja456:5.3: Atthampi te nābhijānāmi kattaṃ, pubbe ca kho [pubbeva kho (syā. ka.)] saṅgatimattamāsi.
segments.ja456:6.1: Paṭhamaṃ idaṃ dassanaṃ jānato me, na tābhijānāmi ito puratthā;
segments.ja456:6.3: Akkhāhi me pucchito etamatthaṃ, kadā kuhiṃ vā ahu saṅgamo no.
segments.ja456:7.1: Gandhārarājassa puramhi ramme, avasimhase takkasīlāyaṃ deva;
segments.ja456:7.3: Tatthandhakāramhi timīsikāyaṃ [timissikāyaṃ (sī. aṭṭha.), timissakāyaṃ (syā.)], aṃsena aṃsaṃ samaghaṭṭayimha.
segments.ja456:8.1: Te tattha ṭhatvāna ubho janinda, sārāṇiyaṃ [sāraṇīyaṃ (ka.)] vītisārayimha [vītisārimha (sī. syā. pī.)] tattha;
segments.ja456:8.3: Sāyeva no saṅgatimattamāsi, tato na pacchā na pure ahosi.
segments.ja456:9.1: Yadā kadāci manujesu brahme, samāgamo sappurisena hoti;
segments.ja456:9.3: Na paṇḍitā saṅgatisanthavāni, pubbe kataṃ vāpi vināsayanti.
segments.ja456:10.1: Bālāva [bālā ca (sī. syā. pī.)] kho saṅgatisanthavāni, pubbe kataṃ vāpi vināsayanti;
segments.ja456:10.3: Bahumpi bālesu kataṃ vinassati, tathā hi bālā akataññurūpā.
segments.ja456:11.1: Dhīrā ca kho saṅgatisanthavāni, pubbe kataṃ vāpi na nāsayanti;
segments.ja456:11.3: Appampi dhīresu kataṃ na nassati, tathā hi dhīrā sukataññurūpā.
segments.ja456:12.1: Dadāmi te gāmavarāni pañca, dāsīsataṃ satta gavaṃsatāni;
segments.ja456:12.3: Parosahassañca suvaṇṇanikkhe, bhariyā ca te sādisī dve dadāmi.
segments.ja456:13.1: Evaṃ sataṃ hoti samecca rāja, nakkhattarājāriva tārakānaṃ;
segments.ja456:13.3: Āpūratī kāsipatī tathāhaṃ, tayāpi me saṅgamo ajja laddhoti.
